title: NAV-APPLINKS route manifest (FR-NAV-006 / AC-NAV-013)
description: Single-source route manifest for Android App Links. Validated by loadManifest(path): RouteManifest | ManifestError{reason: UNKNOWN_HOST | BAD_PATTERN | MISSING_FINGERPRINT, detail}. Semantic checks enforced by the loader (T3): every routes[].host must appear in hosts[] (else UNKNOWN_HOST), every routes[].pathPattern must compile as an ECMAScript regex (else BAD_PATTERN), sha256CertFingerprints must be non-empty (else MISSING_FINGERPRINT with detail naming the offending field path, e.g. 'sha256CertFingerprints'). autoVerify defaults to true when omitted. Route-descriptor field names (host, routeId, query, QueryParam{name, type, required}) reuse include/navigation/trie.h.

hosts.description: Allowlisted App Links hosts. Every routes[].host must equal one entry (else UNKNOWN_HOST).

schemes.description: Allowlisted URI schemes. Must include 'https'; custom schemes are allowlisted explicitly here.

routes.description: One entry per deep-link route. Field names mirror trie.h RouteEntry/QueryParam.

host.description: Owning host; must appear in top-level hosts[] (else UNKNOWN_HOST, detail carries 'routes[<i>].host').

pathPattern.description: ECMAScript regex matched against the URI path. Must compile (else BAD_PATTERN, detail carries 'routes[<i>].pathPattern'). Must start with '/'.

query.description: Typed query-param schema for this route (trie.h RouteEntry.query).

required.description: Missing required param rejects ingress URI with BAD_PARAM (trie.h QueryParam.required).

enum.description: Optional allowlist of accepted string values for this param.

default.description: Optional default value used when the param is absent and not required.

sha256CertFingerprints.description: SHA-256 signing-cert fingerprints for assetlinks.json. Must be non-empty (else MISSING_FINGERPRINT, detail carries 'sha256CertFingerprints').

autoVerify.description: Drives android:autoVerify on generated intent-filters. Defaults to true when omitted.

$comment: Error shape: ManifestError{reason: UNKNOWN_HOST | BAD_PATTERN | MISSING_FINGERPRINT, detail: string} where detail carries the offending field path (e.g. 'routes[0].host', 'routes[0].pathPattern', 'sha256CertFingerprints'). loadManifest is pure parse+validate with no I/O beyond read and no network.
